archived_rule: Replace FAMILY with Jaccard 1-NN only if development grouped-CV mean macro-F1 is clearly better than Extra Trees (+0.02 or both macro-F1 and balanced accuracy, with BA not materially worse) and the independent hybrid then improves both Stage-2 and end-to-end macro-F1 while Stage-1 AUROC stays at the frozen LightGBM value.
conclusion: Original final family-head adoption consulted held-out Stage-2 and end-to-end metrics. The repaired fixed architecture is evaluated exploratorily on the same holdout; this refit is not an independent confirmatory validation.
